[[Deadly Cargo (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Deadly cargo map.jpg]] | minimission = y }} Put a stop to the [[Jade Brotherhood]]'s plans in [[Seitung Harbor]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Clear the Jade Brotherhood out of Seitung Harbor. * See [[Guardsman Qao Lin]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,500 [[Experience]] *1,000 [[Gold]] *[[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] *[[Imperial Commendation]] == Walkthrough == Work your way through the zone to clear out the Jade Brotherhood forces. Pay attention to the [[Jade Brotherhood Demolitionist]]s, who can easily wipe your party using the suicide skill, [[Jade Brotherhood Bomb]]. The Jade groups stand still before you [[aggro]] them, making them vulnerable to [[area of effect]] skills. It should be easy to [[pull]] the Demolitionists away from the adjacent groups, since they are not connected to the other mobs. Demolitionists activate their self-destruct skill as soon as an enemy is close, so you can get them to waste their bomb by sending in one token character to trigger it. * As you approach the dock, [[Miku]] joins the party; she will respawn if she dies. However, while alive she has a tendency to over-aggro, so try to pull foes toward your group. Due to the minimal spacing between enemy groups in this quest it is necessary to carefully manage your aggro and it is advisable therefore to avoid Miku as long as possible. * There are no [[resurrection shrine]]s in the area — a party [[wipe]] will result in mission failure. * The Demolitionists are considered [[boss]]es. If you kill them before they blow up, you gain a [[morale boost]]. ; Skill recommendations * AoE skills, especially [[Panic]], since your opponents are heavily clumped. * To counter the demolitionists: ** [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support]] will trigger them well away from the party. ** [[Snare (tactic)|snares]], [[minion]]s, or [[spirit]] walls will also keep them away from the party. ** Their bombing skill can be [[interrupt]]ed during its long [[activation time]]. * [[Damage reduction#Threshold damage reduction|Damage cappers]] like [[Shelter]] can allow your party to survive the explosions. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]]s *{{a}} 20 [[Miku]] (upon approaching the pier) ===Foes=== Humans ([[Jade Brotherhood]]) *{{w}}{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Warrior]] *{{r}}{{a}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Ranger]] *{{mo}}{{d}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Monk]] *{{n}}{{me}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Necromancer]] *{{me}}{{n}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Mesmer]] *{{e}}{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Elementalist]] *{{a}}{{n}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Assassin]] *{{rt}}{{p}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Ritualist]] ====Bosses==== Humans (Jade Brotherhood) *{{a}} 30 (30) [[Jade Brotherhood Demolitionist]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Guardsman Qao Lin :''"Good timing. I've gotten wind of something that the Jade Brotherhood has been up to, and I find it worrisome. They've had several ships coming in to Seitung Harbor, which is unusual for them. I can only imagine that they're trying to get something in without either the [[Imperial Guard]] or the [[Ministry of Purity]] noticing. Even the optimist in me can't find anything good in that.'' :''"Whatever they're up to, we need to stop them. I can make preparations for your travel posthaste, just let me know as soon as you're ready."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = Whatever they think they're hiding, it won't get by me. | decline = Maybe they're just interested in some recreational sailing? | ask = Whatever the Jade Brotherhood is up to, I know two things for certain: It isn't good, and it needs to be stopped. Are you ready to go? }} {{ Offer dialog | accept = I've been ready. | decline = I'm harboring a lot of doubt about this. | indent = ::: }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== Upon starting quest: :'''Jade Brotherhood Demolitionist:''' ''"We've been spotted! Demolitionists, keep planting those explosives. If they try to stop you, you know what to do!"'' :''':''' ''"Demolitionists? They're trying to destroy the harbor! We need to stop them!"'' Once at the bottom of the stairs: :'''Miku:''' ''"Here I was looking for [[Guardsman Jinnai|Jinnai]], and instead I find you...getting into trouble again! Let me lend you a hand!"'' After defeating all of the Jade Brotherhood: :'''Miku:''' ''"That appears to have been the last of them. Are you unharmed?"'' :''':''' ''"I'm fine. Fighting the Jade Brotherhood is nothing new for me. How has your search gone?"'' :'''Miku:''' ''"Heh. I search for answers, and find only more questions. Jinnai is gone. No one knows where, or what has happened to him. And that tells me one thing for certain: what he knows is dangerous."'' :'''Miku:''' ''"If he has fled, then I need to find him before [[Reiko]] does. I will continue my search. Will you be alright on your own?"'' :''':''' ''"I can handle myself, don't worry about that. You take care of Jinnai. I'm going to try and put a stop to the aggression between the gangs and the Ministry of Purity."'' :'''Miku:''' ''"A show-off, huh? I think you and I are going to work together just fine. Heh! Good luck out there, friend."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Guardsman Qao Lin :''"Trying to smuggle in explosives? This is quickly getting out of hand. Every time I think we're putting out a fire, it seems that we're just adding fuel to start several more. I don't know what it's going to take to end this, but for now, we just have to do the best that we can. That's really all we can do. I refuse to give up faith, and I truly believe that we can make things better."''
